claims.claim: Cognee integration is absent; an ice-memory plugin is unrelated.
claims.finding: The local Rust crates/packages have no Cognee client/lifecycle integration. A companion ice-memory implementation is not present in this checkout, so its external behavior is unverified rather than asserted equivalent or unrelated. TS source sizes and bundled skill paths match the inspected files.

claims.claim: Prompt hook adds scoped recall, skips under four words and deduplicates.
claims.finding: Signal words contain a Unicode letter/number; successful exact session+raw-prompt requests suppress repeats for 15000 ms. Failures remain retryable and short/skipped prompts can still consume a last-compaction injection.

claims.claim: Tool results capture allowlisted tools with a per-turn limit.
claims.finding: Exact allowlist and lower-case acceptance, 24 attempted traces per prompt, per-parameter caps and textual result capture are specified. Failed capture still consumes the slot.

claims.claim: Agent end remembers QA and idle improves/dreams with cooldown.
claims.finding: QA uses one pending prompt and the last assistant text, regardless of stop reason. Current-session improve and old-session dream are distinct, revision-fenced flows. HTTP acceptance is not server consolidation completion; warmup retry is a third flow.

claims.claim: Compaction can be owned/contributed and checkpoint recall is handed to Blackhole.
claims.finding: Default auto/defer never owns the summary. Explicit own compiles a local anchor and visible text without a Cognee summary request. Checkpoint recall is separately opt-in, config-detected Blackhole-only, and binds the handoff to the original host session ID.
Tracked captures/drains settle before final current-session improve and optional unregister. No global shutdown deadline or server completion poll is provided.
The three bundled skill documents are always returned, even when memory is disabled; runtime-specific asset resolution is in config.ts, not the storage-compatibility helper.

Root is a lexical resolved path found by at most 24 .git-existence checks, not realpath or Git canonical root. Basename is sanitized/clipped to 40 and SHA-256 prefix is eight hex characters. Default dataset is literal ice, not $project.

claims.claim: Local HTTP client with a circuit breaker and env/cache credential sources; shared .env is nonsecret-only.
claims.finding: The default endpoint is loopback but any HTTP/S URL is accepted. Two extension-owned breakers gate selected automatic paths, not all client requests. Credential order includes explicit options, process, ICE cache, shared-plugin cache and shared .env. The parser explicitly accepts COGNEE_API_KEY, so the nonsecret-only claim is false.

claims.claim: cognee_search, slash commands and a settings section are available.
claims.finding: Full tool schema, 14 command forms/branch precedence and eight settings descriptors are specified; manual improve and remember have different gating/replay rules from automatic flows.

claims.claim: Every request is appended redacted to a size-capped observations log.
claims.finding: Only instrumented call sites emit observations. The observer redacts preview only; some error/metadata/base URL displays remain unsanitized. Rotation occurs after append at more than 2 MiB, keeps one .1 generation and is serialized only within a process. Reads return at most 500 valid-ish recent lines but read full files first.
All ten are resolved with strict types and exact names. COGNEE_BASE_URL/LOCAL_API_URL and API-key sources are additional supported inputs; numeric settings do not have environment overrides.

unverified.finding: External ice-memory plugin implementation is not in the local checkout and network access is prohibited. No parity claim is made about that external package.

open_questions.question: Should Rust retain enabled capture/recall by default and unrestricted HTTP/S endpoint selection, or add an explicit consent/trust boundary before sending prompt/tool data?
Should ambiguous manual remembers and warmup writes be quarantined rather than automatically replayed, and should pending records gain path validation and cross-process claims?
Should late capture/registration/observation completions be fenced to their original session, and should all state reset when one extension instance changes session?
Should health and shutdown receive hard total deadlines, all observed fields be redacted, and successful improve mean a confirmed server job completion rather than request acceptance?
Should manual improve obey enabled/claim/in-flight policy, settings writes be awaited/serialized, and the displayed settings values refresh from loaded configuration?

dependency_resolutions.capability: canonical agent directory and no-op legacy environment normalization
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The pure configuration resolver already specifies the shallow-copy environment normalizer. Canonical agent-directory lookup is performed by connection/storage callers, not by resolveIceCogneeConfig itself. Keep these exact identity helpers as shared references; do not require the whole settings subsystem to implement the pure validator.

dependency_resolutions.capability: credential directory location and source-safe diagnostic handling
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Connection lookup calls canonical getAgentDir and the exact ice-cognee path helper. keySource labels and omission of secret text are already COG-003 behavior; they do not require provider OAuth or an observability database.

dependency_resolutions.capability: shared credential redaction regexes and UTF-16 compatibility
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Both entries use utils/redact.ts. COG-007 already includes the exact credential-text regexes and UTF-16 cap; OBS-012 adds store-specific key redaction and SQLite retention. Treat OBS-012 as the shared-helper owner/reference, not a prerequisite to initialize SQLite before formatting Cognee memory.

dependency_resolutions.capability: hidden before-user extension initialization, session identity and lifecycle delivery
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The supplied factory requires inline ordering, live guarded session identity/context and awaited lifecycle dispatch. The session binding/reload consumer is SESSION-035. Loading and background-drain state remain COG-owned.

dependency_resolutions.capability: tool-result argument/result payload and session-safe lifecycle contexts
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The requested tool-result event belongs at COG-047, whose handler constructs the payload consumed by COG-044.storeEntry. storeEntry itself consumes an ordinary record and can also be called for QA captures. Relocate the tool-result/context prerequisites to COG-047; do not force a result-hook dependency onto the generic sender.

The before_agent_start reducer supplies the chained transient system prompt and the live signal. Cognee owns passing that signal into recall. The host does not guarantee cancellation races, timeout, or a late-result session fence beyond the stated source behavior.

dependency_resolutions.capability: compaction preparation/reason/signal and host session identity
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The producer needs actual compaction preparation, manual/automatic reason and signal, and current host session identity. BLACK-037 consumes the optional file; it is not required to create the producer or to perform ordinary Cognee recall.

The generic session_before_compact reducer owns ordered whole-result replacement and cancel handling. Session owners apply/save the result; COG-052's deterministic own-summary compiler does not append its own checkpoint.

dependency_resolutions.capability: post-compaction event details and ordered custom-entry persistence
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Manual and automatic session_compact events follow the committed checkpoint and expose entry/details/fromExtension. Cognee then appends its separate queue-state custom entry through EXT-053 using session persistence. Do not create or persist a second compaction entry.

dependency_resolutions.capability: tool registration with schema/cancellation/details and active-tool state
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Registration, fresh-context execution with signal/details, and active-tool mutation are required. The shared execution validator remains AI-012; provider sampling or successful registration does not validate an invocation.

dependency_resolutions.capability: namespaced settings descriptors and change callbacks
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The named settings descriptor/onChange host API is EXT-016. TUI-025 displays and dispatches those descriptors. Cognee owns its separate JSON persistence and its nonawaited save behavior; these are not core settings.json keys.

dependency_resolutions.capability: bundled skill discovery through the resource loader
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Bundled path derivation, resource reload/admission, skill discovery and attributed resources_discover results are actual integration prerequisites. Cognee advertises the directory even while disabled; the resource loader owns use and trust of the returned Markdown.

dependency_resolutions.capability: live Cognee observation projection into the run recorder
dependency_resolutions.rationale: Cognee emits observations before its own serialized file append. OBS-008 subscribes and projects them; it already depends on COG-059. The producer must not acquire a reverse dependency on the recorder.

dependency_resolutions.capability: status slots and safe lifecycle of retired UI contexts
dependency_resolutions.rationale: The required public capability is keyed setStatus plus stale-context invalidation. TUI-037 owns the footer map/display consumer; it is not a prerequisite for headless or RPC-capable Cognee execution. Cognee owns its 180 ms timer and stale-access catch.
